note: The one list of every strategy and its stage. Edit it by a reviewed pull request. It holds no live figures: names, stage, rules in plain words, dates, and an n only when it comes from public data (nBasis says which).

strategies.name: Gold closing buy
strategies.rule: Gold: the favourite side at 88c to 97c, about 6 minutes before the close
strategies.kill: Gold kill latch: off for good at a drawdown of $58.75 from its own peak, or net under -$20 after 40 trades; only a reviewed edit re-arms it
strategies.return: Shadow profit factor 1.3+ over at least 60 trades and 7 days, second half 1.3+, then a reviewed re-arm at half size for the first 30 trades (GOLDOFF supplies the record)
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: whether the gold kill latch has tripped as of today; the page's live card shows the latch state from the bot, this row only states the rule

strategies.name: Open interest jump
strategies.rule: Bitcoin: the cheaper side at 5c to 50c after an open interest jump, held to settlement
strategies.nextReadText: Forward read date in the bot's registry
strategies.kill: Drawdown stop of $50 from its own peak, 24 losses in a row, or net under -$6 after 40 fills; never re-armed automatically
strategies.return: Only a reviewed edit by the owner re-arms it
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: lifecycle section 7f lists OICORE as a Probe (under 100 fills); the page has always shown it in the Live lane

strategies.name: Release day longshot
strategies.rule: Release mornings: the cheaper side at 5c to 50c in the 8:30 window, held to settlement
strategies.nextReadText: Forward read date in the bot's registry
strategies.kill: 20 losses in a row, or net under $0 after 40 fills
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: return rule is not written; lifecycle section 7f lists it as a Probe (thin sample)

strategies.name: Gold return record
strategies.rule: Logs gold's own entry (the favourite side at 88c to 97c, 330 to 400 seconds left) whether or not gold is latched off, so gold's return rule can be checked
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Earliest return review: 7 days after the first row, and only once 60 settled rows exist
strategies.nBasis: Shadow rows the bot logs from public quotes; the count is shown from the private log, not stored here
strategies.kill: Log only, no order. Nothing to kill; it is the return evidence for gold
strategies.return: Gold may return only at shadow profit factor 1.3+ over at least 60 trades and 7 days, second half 1.3+, then a reviewed re-arm at half size
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: first-row date (set from the registration date, not the first logged row)

strategies.name: Sports spread cheap side
strategies.rule: Sports SPREAD markets: one market per event nearest 50c, buy the YES side at 5c to 15c about two days before the game, hold
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: One read, after the owner merges PR 804 and the SPREADLISTS then SPREADCELL1 jobs run
strategies.nBasis: Public Kalshi market data only (about 320 observations expected)
strategies.kill: Net under -$6 after 60 settled fills, or 25 losses in a row
strategies.return: A 14 day cool-off, then a paper record of 100 fills at cash PF 1.3+, then the owner's approval
notes: Odds stated in the spec: 3 to 5 percent that it clears its first line. A clear is not a pass of the research bar
to confirm with the Head of R&D: stage name (the spec calls it a conditional probe spec, the owner lists it as shadow); start date; n

strategies.name: Approval NO side
strategies.rule: Approval markets: the NO side; the development pull (NOSIDE1_CANDLES) has not run
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: After the candle pull jobs 1 and 2 are on the data branch
strategies.nBasis: Public Kalshi candles; paper observations are small and lean against the idea
strategies.kill: to confirm with the Head of R&D
strategies.return: to confirm with the Head of R&D
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: exact rule, n, start date, kill and return rules; the queue says only that what is held leans against it

strategies.name: Spot lead
strategies.rule: Bitcoin 15 minute market priced from Coinbase one minute candles against the Kalshi book; a read-time shadow
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Re-read about Nov 21 to 23, judged only on unseen windows
strategies.nBasis: Development read of public candle data (missed its bar); not the shadow's own count
strategies.kill: Misses its registered bar on the re-read, or the owner does not accept the venue risk in writing
strategies.return: Cannot go live as registered: needs the owner's written exception to the favourite-and-hold ban and a ruling on the Coinbase terms
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: exact kill rule and the bar numbers; the venue is barred from live probes by the owner's Nov 12 ruling

strategies.name: Bitcoin model on Kalshi candles
strategies.rule: Two minutes before a Bitcoin 15 minute market closes, the cheap side (5c to 30c) when a model fed by Kalshi's own Bitcoin perpetual says it is underpriced by 5c or more
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Read-time shadow from Nov 23; the held-out read is first allowed Nov 20; development waits on the perpetual candle pull (PR 810)
strategies.kill: Net under -$6 after 40 settled fills, or 18 losses in a row (if it were ever live)
strategies.return: A 14 day cool-off, a paper record at cash PF 1.3+ on 100 rows, the owner's approval
notes: Honest odds in the spec: low single digits that it reaches a popup
to confirm with the Head of R&D: the registered start date (Nov 23 is the shadow read-time start in the queue)

strategies.name: Combo house side
strategies.rule: Combos: NO at about 60c to 90c, held to settlement, on paper first (the owner's written exception to the favourite-and-hold ban)
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nBasis: Public combo quotes recorded to the combo-data branch
strategies.kill: Stop if fewer than 20 combos ever showed a two-sided quote with a bid, or fewer than 100 trades
strategies.return: to confirm with the Head of R&D
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: the rule is still being registered by Desk B; a $2 probe needs a paper edge of 10c per dollar over 100 settled combos, not before December

strategies.name: Two-sided market making
strategies.return: Only with a new fill mechanism or venue (declined list, lifecycle 7e)
strategies.reason: Closed by evidence: the simulated profit came from a fill rule that left out through-price fills; the registered Nov 24 held-out reads still happen once to complete the record
